id: title:Gilbert09:accept a pasted atlassian site url as the subdomain

observations.behavior: Adds a URL parsing and stripping step before credential probing.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to accept full URLs or hosts instead of requiring bare subdomains.

observations.behavior: Normalizes the input before checking validity; also updates error message for clarity.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes user-facing guidance when an invalid host is supplied, while preserving existing behavior for valid inputs.

observations.behavior: Tests that requests are made against the normalized origin regardless of pasted format.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection and demonstrates expected HTTP targets after normalization.

observations.limitations: Only one connector implementation shown. No change to shared configuration or global defaults. Tests do not cover failure paths where normalization could produce unexpected results.

review.limitations: Only one connector implementation shown. No change to shared configuration or global defaults. Tests do not cover failure paths where normalization could produce unexpected results.
review.reason: The patch adds bounded utility: it normalizes Jira subdomain inputs across relevant entry points and preserves correctness with tests. It does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or wider architectural changes.
review.posthog_relevance: Helps warehouse setup UX by accepting common URL/host formats without changing API compatibility.
review.uncertainty: Could be a small maintenance improvement rather than substantive capability depending on adoption and prior support.
